# Tendies archive technique audit

Reference repository https://github.com/SerStars/Nugget-Wallpapers and gallery https://cowabun.ga/wallpapers.
Pinned repository revision a8e91782048c76143df2551f8616c710ee7660cc. Every .tendies blob under wallpapers/ in the complete non-truncated recursive tree was downloaded and Git blob SHA-1 verified, then independently SHA-256 catalogued. 140 archives, 1700238137 compressed bytes, 2184916285 expanded bytes. Templates are included wherever they appear under wallpapers/. No reference script or CAML was executed.

## Licensing and isolation

Repository LICENSE is GPL-3.0. CONTRIBUTING requires permission for contributed artwork; this does not establish that every submitted image is cleared. Asset-specific LICENSE.txt in Crome-Hearts-v2.tendies, Dark.tendies, PurpleShapes.tendies declares CC BY-NC 4.0, not blanket GPL artwork permission. No external artwork is shipped by this audit. Generate only user-provided image assets and retain the existing PocketPoster GPL notices and complete combined corresponding source. Original source/license files and complete metadata are retained in the separate reference workspace, outside app resources.
Archives were bounded before extraction, absolute/traversal/backslash/NUL paths and symlinks rejected, per-entry/archive/corpus size and compression-ratio limits applied. __MACOSX, .DS_Store, and ._ entries are omitted. CAML is parsed as data only, XML entities rejected, scripts not executed. Metadata parser failures are preserved rather than treated as evidence of successful runtime support.

## Observed structures and exact examples

Single wallpaper.ca appears in WheresWaldo, Graduation_Album and A$AP_ROCKY. Their actual Wallpaper.plist assets.lockAndHome.default uses assetFileName=wallpaper.ca and type=ParameterizedCA; family=Marble, version=6, contentVersion=1.07, logicalScreenClass=any, wantsDeviceMotion=true. Their copied productTypes=iPhone18,3 and Lavender/7920 names are reference-specific, NOT proof of universal compatibility and must not be blindly reused. Root document index.xml points to main.caml. assetManifest.caml holds MicaAssetManifest/modules NSArray, not a list of PNG references.
Cipher and SuperMarioBros use assets.lockAndHome.default type=LayeredAnimation plus backgroundAnimationFileName, floatingAnimationFileNameKey and foregroundAnimationFileName. Their three WWDC2022 CA bundles each include main.caml/index.xml/assetManifest.caml. The descriptor is a separate UUID container, versions/1. Clock-relative routing must be implemented by these real three roles in depth mode. Single wallpaper.ca is valid for simple mode and is not a malformed missing-three-bundle archive.
Each own image must be a distinct CALayer with nested contents/CGImage src="assets/own-image.png", transparency retained. Preserve explicit manual layer order and crop/zoom/offset. New descriptor IDs must match role/descriptor identifiers and suggestion metadata, not repeat sample IDs. Cipher has providerInfo.plist, complicationLayout, titleStyleConfiguration, RuntimeSnapshotMetadata-home/lock, supplements/0/homescreenConfiguration, contents otherMetadata.plist, .configurableOptions.plist and userInfo. Some are keyed archives, not ordinary shallow dictionaries. Compare decoded values and remap only own identity fields.

## Motion evidence and limitations

SuperMarioBros Floating main.caml has LKState Locked/Unlock/Sleep and LKStateSetValue targetId="#1" keyPath="position". Locked/Sleep value CGPoint 195.11 845.266; Unlock 195.11 1.266. LKStateTransition fromState="*" toState="Unlock" contains LKStateTransitionElement targetId="#1" key="position" and CASpringAnimation damping=50 mass=2 stiffness=300 velocity=0 duration=0.8 fillMode=backwards. This is state-driven slide, not gyro. Unlock zoom requires corresponding transform state setters/transitions with actual targets, never simply renaming a timer animation.
Graduation_Album actual root style/wallpaperParallaxGroups NSArray contains NSDictionary axis=x/y, image=null, keyPath=transform.translation.x/y, layerName="Transform Layer 1", mapMaxTo=50/70, mapMinTo=-50/-70, view=Floating. RollingHills has the same sensor-mapping structure, some position.x/y mappings and named target layers. wantsDeviceMotion=true accompanies these in Wallpaper.plist. This is positive static evidence of motion-driven mappings distinct from CAKeyframeAnimation loops. It is NOT on-device proof of iOS 26/27 support. Gyro must default off and use this structure only if the generated variant actually supports it, with honest device-test caveat.
Graduation_Album also has independent looping CAKeyframeAnimation position.x/y and transform.rotation.z. Floating timed animation is permitted as floating animation, never described as sensor parallax. Emitters, replicators, filters and HEIC assets observed in the full corpus are catalogued below; presence alone does not authorize adding untested arbitrary effects.

## Implementation reconciliation status before the effect patch

At audit time app HEAD 9a192c8e736634de452a1fbdad377a0583253af0 still emits two legacy iPad Background/Floating bundles, lacks assetManifest generation and depth foreground routing, and has empty states. Delivery is blocked. This document is source preparation, NOT a claim those missing features are implemented. Required next patch implements simple single-bundle and opt-in genuine triple-bundle depth, genuine optional motion/state effects, full metadata and per-generated-ZIP tests, all five locales. AI stays staged/default off with no production calls.

## Implementation patch, device validation still pending
The working patch now writes simple ParameterizedCA wallpaper.ca or explicit opt-in three-bundle LayeredAnimation Background/Floating/Foreground; own PNGs, MicaAssetManifest and index in each. Optional unlock zoom/slide LKState and CASpringAnimation, independent 6-second floating, and exact gyro mappings default OFF. Resource metadata is authored from decoded schema, not reference artwork. Structural XCTest and same-HEAD IPA/launch CI are mandatory before distribution. Static evidence is not an iOS 27 device pass. Favorites beyond these primitives are studied and catalogued, not falsely advertised as implemented.
